說明: 《畫海人》裝備圖示（115 件，一件一張）。名稱是「裝_」加上 畫海人/js/data.js 的 EQUIPS 名稱。存成 img/gear/名稱.webp（256×256，透明背景）。

style.gear: Anime film game item icon: exactly one object, centred, filling about two thirds of the frame, seen from a slight three-quarter angle, in the same hand-painted anime film style as the game's scenes: clean crisp line art, cel shading, soft painterly highlights. Medieval European craftsmanship. Bright, clear true colours with a soft rim light so it reads at small size; a muted base palette with warm highlights on metal, glass and anything that glows. Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no table, no scenery, no frame, no border. No text, letters or numbers anywhere; any writing is drawn as abstract squiggles. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
